name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump Stokes Islamophobia by Calling Democratic Candidates ‘Jihadists’
changes.summary: Along with his comments about Muslim candidates, Mr. Trump spoke disparagingly of Somalis in the United States, saying “they’re not smart.”.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

changes.title: Omar says federal agent was posted outside monthly meeting in Minneapolis suburb
changes.summary: Democratic U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar says a Homeland Security Investigations agent was outside her monthly town hall meeting in Richfield, Minnesota, on Thursday.

changes.title: At least 200 major wildfires burn across U.S. and Canada
changes.summary: Hot and dry conditions are fueling at least 200 major wildfires in the western U.S. and Canada. Meanwhile, images show the scale of destruction in Spokane, Washington, from the fires there last week. Ian Lee reports.

changes.title: A midwife crosses 'maternity deserts' to make a difference for Black moms and babies
changes.summary: New research from the March of Dimes says more than half of U.S. counties have no labor and delivery hospitals. One Black midwife tries to make a difference for moms in Alabama. (Image credit: Maria Fabrizio).

changes.title: U.S. Says It Revoked More Than 175,000 Visas Under Trump
changes.summary: Most visas were rescinded over criminal accusations, the State Department said, while some were revoked from people who had celebrated the assassination of Charlie Kirk.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: A U.S. official tells NBC News that President Trump's team used an elaborate ruse to fly him out of Turkey after the NATO Summit amid threats to his life during the Iran war. NBC News' Shannon Pettypiece has details on the plan to keep the president's true location hidden.

changes.title: Trump took a secret flight out of Turkey in an elaborate plot to hide his location amid Iran war
changes.summary: President Donald Trump was whisked out of Turkey last month on a military aircraft in an elaborate plot to keep his location secret amid security fears from the war with neighboring Iran, according to a U.S. official with knowledge of the plan.

changes.title: Why Rumors About Morocco Followed Spain’s Ceuta Migrant Surge
changes.summary: Claims swirled that Morocco, perhaps spurred by Israel and the United States, organized a recent border disaster. That unproven speculation, experts said, was exacerbated by the region’s complicated history.

changes.title: The U.S. Supreme Court Will Hear a Major Climate Change Case This Fall
changes.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court building on May 4, 2026 in Washington, DC. —Andrew Harnik—Getty Images The Supreme Court is set to hear oral arguments this fall in a landmark case to determine whether local and state governments can sue fossil fuel companies for climate-related disaster costs.
